description: Convert a lead into a contact, company, and/or deal (select at least one via the input flags). Sets the lead status to converted. Use search_leads first to find the lead id. The result echoes the operating workspace.

id.description: The lead id returned by search_leads.

input.description: Conversion options that decide whether to create/link contact, company and deal records.

companyName.description: Name for the company to create. Required when createCompany is true.

contactFirstName.description: First name for the contact to create. Required when createContact is true.

contactLastName.description: Last name for the contact to create. Optional.

createCompany.description: Create (or link) a company from the lead. Default false.

createContact.description: Create (or link) a contact from the lead. Default false.

createDeal.description: Create an open pipeline deal from the lead. Default false.

dealAmount.description: Deal amount, as a decimal string. Used when createDeal is true.

dealNextActionDate.description: ISO 8601 next-action date for the created deal. Used when createDeal is true.

dealNextActionNote.description: Next-action note for the created deal. Used when createDeal is true.

dealTitle.description: Title for the created deal. Required when createDeal is true.

name: convert_lead
title: Convert lead
